list.title: My terminals
list.lead: Passport, tariffs and spots are managed here. An active terminal is listed in the catalog and can be booked.
list.emptyHint: Only the owner adds a terminal to the catalog: passport, tariffs and spots stay under your control.

form.unsavedTabs: Tariffs and spots open once the terminal is saved. Save the Details section first.

hint.org: Only on behalf of a TERMINAL organization. Cannot be changed later.
hint.station: The station the terminal is connected to.
hint.map: Click the map or drag the marker: coordinates fill in automatically.
hint.hours: At most two ranges per day. A day without ranges is a day off.
hint.services: An enabled service can be tariffed and ordered. Lead time: how many minutes ahead a client must order (0 = immediately).
hint.photos: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB each

form.noOrg: A terminal is added only on behalf of a TERMINAL organization. Set that kind on your organization.
form.published: Terminal is active: listed in the catalog and bookable.
form.hidden: Terminal hidden: not shown in the catalog.

err.NOT_TERMINAL_ADMIN: You cannot manage a terminal for this organization: owner or terminal admin required.
err.TERMINAL_UNCLAIMED: The terminal is not attached to an organization yet. Wait for the claim decision.

tariffs.lead: A tariff is published as a new version: the previous one closes on the effective date, history is kept.
tariffs.empty: No tariffs published. Without a tariff the terminal shows price on request and cannot be booked.

hint.cargoGroup: Leave empty for all cargo. Pick an ETSNG group to limit the tariff to it.
hint.validFrom: Empty: from now. The current tariff closes on that day.
hint.priceSom: Enter in som, converted to tiyin automatically.
hint.noServices: Enable services in the Details section first.

err.TARIFF_OVERLAP: A future tariff already exists for this service and cargo group. Pick a date after it.
err.TARIFF_VALID_FROM_BEFORE_CURRENT: The date cannot be before the current tariff started.
err.VALID_FROM_IN_PAST: The date cannot be in the past.
err.TERMINAL_UNCLAIMED: The terminal is not attached to an organization yet.
err.NOT_TERMINAL_ADMIN: No access: owner or terminal admin required.

slots.lead: Capacity per window: how many wagon batches each window accepts. Clients book free spots.

capacity.title: Open capacity
capacity.hint: Existing spots get the new capacity; it cannot go below what is already booked.

grid.title: Next 14 days
grid.empty: No spots opened for this period. Open capacity above.
grid.legend: Cell: free places, small number booked + held. Click to close or reopen a spot.

err.CAPACITY_BELOW_BOOKED: Capacity cannot be below what is booked.
err.RANGE_TOO_LONG: Range too long (60 days at most).
err.INVALID_WINDOW_TIME: Invalid window time: end must be after start.
err.TERMINAL_UNCLAIMED: The terminal is not attached to an organization yet.
err.NOT_TERMINAL_ADMIN: No access: owner or terminal admin required.

claim.sent: Claim sent. The operator will review it; once approved the terminal appears in your dashboard under My terminals.
claim.pending: This terminal has a pending claim under review.
claim.noOrg: Create a TERMINAL organization in the dashboard first.
claim.already: This terminal has already been claimed.
claim.forbidden: Only the organization owner or a terminal admin can claim.
